DIAGNOSIS READY: Calcific Tendinitis of the Shoulder

The patient's presentation of chronic pain, insidious onset, and difficulty with overhead activities in a 55-year-old woman is clinically inconsistent with cellulitis, which typically presents with acute redness, warmth, and swelling rather than mechanical pain. Based on the imaging requests I just made and the exclusion of nerve involvement or trauma, I have determined the most likely diagnosis is calcific tendinitis, which I will confirm with the MRI results.
